questions.question_hindi:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं: एक को कथन (A) और दूसरे को कारण (R) के रूप में लेबल किया गया है। 
कथन (A): एक सरकारी कर्मचारी जो नियमित आधार पर एक नई पोस्ट पर नियुक्त होता है, वह अपनी पिछली पोस्ट पर स्थायी रूप से अधिकार नहीं रख सकता। 
कारण (R): FR 9(13) के तहत, एक अधिकार उस स्थायी पद को धारण करने का शीर्षक है, जो तब समाप्त हो जाता है जब वह किसी अन्य स्थायी पद पर पुष्टि हो जाते हैं।
options_hindi: दोनों A और R सत्य हैं और R A का सही स्पष्टीकरण है
दोनों A और R सत्य हैं लेकिन R A का सही स्पष्टीकरण नहीं है
A सत्य है लेकिन R गलत है
A और R दोनों गलत हैं
questions.source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; Fundamental and Supplementary Rules FR and SR

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R). 
Assertion (A): A government servant who is appointed to a new post on a regular basis cannot retain a lien on their previous post permanently. 
Reason (R): Under FR 9(13), a lien represents the title of a government servant to hold substantively a permanent post, which ceases once they are confirmed in another permanent post.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
Both A and R are false
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). A permanent government servant holds a lien on a post, which represents the legal title to hold substantively a permanent post under Fundamental Rule 9(13). When appointed and confirmed in another permanent post, the employee acquires a new lien, causing the previous lien to terminate automatically to avoid dual permanent holdings.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। एक स्थायी सरकारी कर्मचारी एक पद पर अधिकार रखता है, जो FR 9(13) के तहत स्थायी पद को धारण करने का कानूनी शीर्षक है। जब किसी अन्य स्थायी पद पर नियुक्त और पुष्टि की जाती है, तो कर्मचारी एक नया अधिकार प्राप्त करता है, जिससे पिछले अधिकार का स्वतः समाप्त होना होता है ताकि दो स्थायी पदों का धारक न हो सके।
questions.topic: Fundamental and Supplementary Rules FR and SR
key_facts: FR 9(13) outlines the rules regarding lien for government servants.
A lien ceases when a government servant is confirmed in a new permanent post.
Printed answer key: (A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A

options_hindi: अनधिकृत अनुपस्थिति की अवधि को प्राधिकरण द्वारा बिना वेतन के असाधारण छुट्टी के रूप में स्वचालित रूप से नियमित किया जाता है
अनधिकृत अनुपस्थिति की अवधि को खाते में उपलब्ध आधी वेतन छुट्टी के संतुलन के खिलाफ स्वचालित रूप से डेबिट किया जाता है

कर्मचारी को एक स्वचालित छुट्टी विस्तार दिया जाता है, जो कि अवधि पर दस प्रतिशत वेतन दंड लगाने के अधीन है

questions.question_english: If a government servant stays absent after the expiry of leave without authorization, what is the consequence under FR 17-A and CCS (Leave) Rules?
options_english: The period of unauthorized absence is automatically regularized as Extraordinary Leave without pay by the authority
The period of unauthorized absence is automatically debited against available Half Pay Leave balance in the account
No leave salary is paid, and it causes a break in service (dies-non) unless regularized
The employee is granted an automatic leave extension subject to imposing a ten percent salary penalty on the period
questions.explanation_english: No leave salary is paid, and it causes a break in service (dies-non) unless regularized. Under Fundamental Rule 17-A and Leave Rules, overstaying sanctioned leave without explicit prior permission results in unauthorized absence. No leave salary is payable for such period, and the absence is treated as dies-non, causing an interruption or break in service unless formally regularized by the competent administrative authority.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। कोई छुट्टी वेतन नहीं दिया जाता है, और यह सेवा में एक ब्रेक का कारण बनता है (डाईस-नॉन) जब तक कि नियमित नहीं किया जाता। मौलिक नियम 17-ए और छुट्टी नियमों के तहत, बिना स्पष्ट पूर्व अनुमति के स्वीकृत छुट्टी की अवधि को पार करना अनधिकृत अनुपस्थिति का परिणाम होता है। ऐसी अवधि के लिए कोई छुट्टी वेतन देय नहीं है, और अनुपस्थिति को डाईस-नॉन के रूप में माना जाता है, जो सेवा में एक रुकावट या ब्रेक का कारण बनता है जब तक कि इसे सक्षम प्रशासनिक प्राधिकरण द्वारा औपचारिक रूप से नियमित नहीं किया जाता।
questions.topic: Fundamental and Supplementary Rules FR and SR
key_facts: Fundamental Rule 17-A outlines the consequences of unauthorized absence.
CCS (Leave) Rules specify that no leave salary is payable during unauthorized absence.
Absence is treated as dies-non unless regularized.
Printed answer key: (C) No leave salary is paid, and it causes a break

questions.question_english: How many days of Casual Leave are generally admissible to teachers in government schools in a calendar year?
options_english: 8 days
10 days
12 days
15 days
questions.explanation_english: Teachers working in government schools and other vacation department staff are eligible for 8 days of Casual Leave in a calendar year. Since vacation staff enjoy scheduled institutional vacations, their annual entitlement of Casual Leave is lower compared to non-vacation staff who do not get school vacations.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। सरकारी स्कूलों में काम करने वाले शिक्षकों और अन्य अवकाश विभाग के कर्मचारियों को एक कैलेंडर वर्ष में 8 दिन सामान्य अवकाश मिलता है। चूंकि अवकाश कर्मचारी निर्धारित संस्थागत छुट्टियों का आनंद लेते हैं, इसलिए उनकी वार्षिक सामान्य अवकाश की पात्रता गैर-अवकाश कर्मचारियों की तुलना में कम होती है, जिन्हें स्कूल की छुट्टियाँ नहीं मिलती हैं।
questions.topic: Fundamental and Supplementary Rules FR and SR
key_facts: Teachers in government schools are entitled to 8 days of Casual Leave.
Casual Leave is lower for vacation staff compared to non-vacation staff.
Printed answer key: (A) 8 days

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements about Commuted Leave:
I. It is granted normally on medical certificate.
II. It can be granted for an approved course of study without a medical certificate in public interest.
III. It can be granted to a female government servant for up to 60 days without a medical certificate in continuation of maternity leave.
IV. If a government servant resigns while on Commuted Leave, it must be converted back to Half Pay Leave and excess salary recovered.
Which of the above statements are correct?
options_english: I, II and IV
I, III and IV
II, III and IV
I, II, III and IV
questions.explanation_english: All statements I, II, III, and IV are correct regarding Commuted Leave. Commuted Leave is granted on medical grounds or for approved study in public interest without a medical certificate. Female employees can take up to 60 days of Commuted Leave following maternity leave without medical certification. If an employee resigns while on Commuted Leave, it must be reconverted to Half Pay Leave for recovery of excess salary.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। समायोजित अवकाश के बारे में सभी कथन I, II, III और IV सही हैं। समायोजित अवकाश चिकित्सा कारणों पर या सार्वजनिक हित में स्वीकृत अध्ययन के लिए चिकित्सा प्रमाणपत्र के बिना दिया जाता है। महिला कर्मचारियों को मातृत्व अवकाश के बाद चिकित्सा प्रमाणपत्र के बिना 60 दिनों तक समायोजित अवकाश लेने की अनुमति है। यदि कोई कर्मचारी समायोजित अवकाश के दौरान इस्तीफा देता है, तो इसे आधे वेतन की छुट्टी में वापस परिवर्तित किया जाना चाहिए ताकि अतिरिक्त वेतन की वसूली की जा सके।
questions.topic: Fundamental and Supplementary Rules FR and SR
key_facts: Commuted Leave can be granted on medical grounds or for approved study.
Female employees can take up to 60 days of Commuted Leave after maternity leave.
Printed answer key: (D) I, II, III and IV

questions.question_english: Which allowance is specifically granted to an employee when they are transferred on deputation to another department in the public interest, in lieu of opting for the pay of the deputation post?
options_english: Deputation (Duty) Allowance
Foreign Service Allowance
Special Compensatory Allowance
Non-Practicing Allowance
questions.explanation_english: When a government servant is transferred on deputation to another department in public interest without opting for the pay scale of the deputation post, they are granted Deputation (Duty) Allowance. This allowance compensates the employee for taking up official responsibilities in a different administrative setup or cadre outside their parent department.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। जब एक सरकारी कर्मचारी को सार्वजनिक हित में दूसरे विभाग में प्रतिनियुक्ति पर स्थानांतरित किया जाता है और वे प्रतिनियुक्ति पद के वेतन का विकल्प नहीं चुनते, तो उन्हें प्रतिनियुक्ति (कार्य) भत्ता दिया जाता है। यह भत्ता कर्मचारी को उनके मूल विभाग से बाहर एक अलग प्रशासनिक सेटअप या श्रेणी में आधिकारिक जिम्मेदारियों को संभालने के लिए मुआवजा प्रदान करता है।
questions.topic: Fundamental and Supplementary Rules FR and SR
key_facts: Deputation (Duty) Allowance is granted during deputation.
It compensates for responsibilities in a different department.
Printed answer key: (A) Deputation (Duty) Allowance

questions.question_english: Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R). Assertion (A): Unutilized joining time can be credited to the Earned Leave account of the government servant. Reason (R): This acts as an incentive for employees to assume charge of their new assignment promptly without exhausting the maximum admissible joining time.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false

questions.explanation_english: Under Central Civil Services Joining Time Rules, unutilized joining time can be credited to the Earned Leave account of a government servant, subject to the maximum accumulation limit. This provision serves as an administrative incentive for employees to assume charge of their new official assignment promptly without exhausting maximum transit days.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा joining time नियमों के तहत, अप्रयुक्त joining time को सरकारी कर्मचारी के अर्जित अवकाश खाते में श्रेय दिया जा सकता है, अधिकतम संचय सीमा के अधीन। यह प्रावधान कर्मचारियों को उनके नए आधिकारिक कार्यभार को शीघ्रता से ग्रहण करने के लिए एक प्रशासनिक प्रोत्साहन के रूप में कार्य करता है, बिना अधिकतम यात्रा दिनों का उपयोग किए।
questions.topic: Fundamental and Supplementary Rules FR and SR
key_facts: Unutilized joining time can be credited to Earned Leave.

questions.question_english: Under FR 9(4), “Cadre” is defined as:
options_english: The physical posting of an employee in a specific department
A group of employees possessing identical educational qualifications
The strength of a service or a part of a service sanctioned as a separate unit
The authorized scale of pay for a particular

questions.question_english:
How is Half Pay Leave (HPL) calculated for an employee who resigns from service before completing the half-year?
(A) They get the full 10 days credit for that half-year regardless of the exact date of resignation
(B) HPL credit is completely non-admissible and cancelled for the entire half-year
(C) HPL is credited at 5/3 days per completed month
(D) HPL is credited only for completed months
options_english: They get the full 10 days credit for that half-year regardless of the exact date of resignation
HPL credit is completely non-admissible and cancelled for the entire half-year
HPL is credited at 5/3 days per completed month
HPL is credited only for completed months
questions.explanation_english: When a government servant resigns or is removed from service before completing a half-year, Half Pay Leave credit for that half-year is calculated proportionately. The leave account is credited at the rate of 5/3 days for each completed calendar month of service rendered during that specific half-year.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। जब एक सरकारी कर्मचारी आधा वर्ष पूरा करने से पहले इस्तीफा देता है या सेवा से हटा दिया जाता है, तो उस आधे वर्ष के लिए आधा वेतन अवकाश का क्रेडिट अनुपात में गणना किया जाता है। अवकाश खाता उस विशेष आधे वर्ष के दौरान प्रदत्त प्रत्येक पूर्ण कैलेंडर महीने के लिए 5/3 दिनों की दर से क्रेडिट किया जाता है।
questions.topic: Fundamental and Supplementary Rules FR and SR
key_facts: Half Pay Leave is credited at the rate of 5/3 days for each completed month.
Printed answer key: (D) HPL is credited only for completed months.

15 days in two half-yearly installments
10 days in two half-yearly installments

questions.explanation_english: For vacation department staff who avail full vacation periods during an academic year, Earned Leave is credited at the rate of 10 days annually. questions.question_english: Mr. Verma, a teacher in a government school, completes 60 years of age on 15th October. According to FR 56, on which date will he effectively retire from government service?
options_english: 15th October (afternoon)
31st October (afternoon)
1st November (afternoon)
30th November (afternoon)
questions.explanation_english: Under Fundamental Rule 56, a government servant whose date of birth falls on any day of a month other than the first day retires on superannuation on the afternoon of the last day of that month. Therefore, an employee turning 60 on 15th October officially retires on 31st October afternoon.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। यदि किसी सरकारी कर्मचारी की जन्मतिथि महीने के पहले दिन के अलावा किसी अन्य दिन पड़ती है, तो वह उस महीने के अंतिम दिन की दोपहर को सेवानिवृत्त होता है। इसलिए, 15 अक्टूबर को 60 वर्ष के होने वाले कर्मचारी की सेवानिवृत्ति 31 अक्टूबर की दोपहर को होगी।
questions.topic: Fundamental and Supplementary Rules FR and SR
key_facts: Fundamental Rule 56 outlines retirement procedures for government servants.
Employees turning 60 on any day other than the first retire on the last day of that month.
Printed answer key: (c) 31st October (afternoon)

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R). 
Assertion (A): House Rent Allowance (HRA) is admissible to a government servant even if they refuse government accommodation allotted to them. 
Reason (R): The purpose of HRA is to provide financial assistance for housing, which becomes inadmissible if an employee refuses the housing facility provided by the government.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: House Rent Allowance is meant to compensate employees for housing expenses. If a government servant refuses government accommodation allotted to them under general pool housing rules, they forfeit eligibility to draw House Rent Allowance. The assertion stating HRA is admissible upon refusal is incorrect, while the reason is correct.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। हाउस रेंट भत्ता कर्मचारियों को आवास खर्चों के लिए मुआवजा देने के लिए है। यदि एक सरकारी कर्मचारी उन्हें आवंटित सरकारी आवास को अस्वीकार करता है, तो वे हाउस रेंट भत्ता प्राप्त करने के लिए पात्रता खो देते हैं। यह कथन कि HRA अस्वीकृति पर स्वीकार्य है, गलत है, जबकि कारण सही है।
questions.topic: Fundamental and Supplementary Rules FR and SR
key_facts: HRA is not admissible if government accommodation is refused.
The purpose of HRA is to assist with housing expenses.
Printed answer key: (d) A is false but R is true.
